free_tier.stated: 'Free tier: 0.5 vCPU and 512 MiB' and 'No credit card. It stays active when you add paid packages, and after you cancel them.' Paid capacity is sold in packages: 'One package is 1 vCPU, 1 GiB of memory and 10 GB of storage' at 'EUR 5 a month each', split across apps and databases, with per-app sizes from '0.25 vCPU and 256 MiB up to 2 vCPU and 2 GiB' and 'Ephemeral disk per app, 2.5 to 20 GB'.

egress.terms: Per-app egress cap by size: Tiny 2.5 MB/s, Small 5 MB/s, Medium 10 MB/s, Large 20 MB/s; ingress uncapped; fair-use terms apply to all traffic. No per-GB egress allowance and no overage price is published: 'There's no usage billing, and traffic spikes don't show up on your invoice.'

notes: Aggregator claim checked: free-for.dev describes '0.5 vCPUs / 512 MiB RAM, European servers, automatic firewall' and the vendor agrees on the shape, so the gap is small. What the aggregator omits: the free allowance survives cancellation of paid packages, and the paid floor is EUR 1.25 for a quarter of a package. No sleep timer is published for the free tier, which would make it one of the few free PaaS tiers that does not scale to zero.
